Subject: SI-CP-0007 cold plate — supplier qualification information request (SUP-07)

Hello,

Thank you for the qualification packet for part SI-CP-0007 rev A. To complete our review, please send the following:

1. 1.capa — Your documented corrective-action (CAPA) procedure, with sample records showing actions tracked to closure.
2. 4.leak_test — The helium leak test report for this part, showing the measured leak rate, with test conditions (6 bar differential, 20 °C) against our limit of ≤ 0.000001 mbar·L/s.
3. 4.burst_pressure — The burst / proof pressure test report, showing proof pressure of at least 3 times the 6 bar maximum operating pressure held for at least 60 s with no rupture.
4. 5.nc_segregation — Your procedure and records for identifying and segregating nonconforming material.

Thank you.

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: Review the mounting-hole pitch capability data behind the Cpk of 1.1673135449987455 (capability_study.md §1.1, n=50). Confirm the raw measurements and what is planned to improve process centering and spread.

Reliability_report.md §1.1 only states that assemblies remain sealed. Ask to see the helium leak test records for this part, the equipment, the test conditions (6 bar, 20 °C) and the measured rates against ≤ 0.000001 mbar·L/s.

Reliability_report.md §9.1 only states that assemblies withstand the proof load. Ask to see the proof test records: pressure reached versus 3 × 6 bar, hold time of at least 60 s, and rupture observations.
